name: @open-autonomy/self-host
description: The Open Autonomy backend deployed bare: the books, the keys, the rails, the stream, the timeline and each project's page, in your own Cloudflare account. No patronage, no public explore page; money in is the operator's mint.

scripts.dev: bun run build && pnpm exec wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --var DEPLOY_COMMIT:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
